notes: Qt 6.12.0; scene graph backend=software; platform=xcb. frame_ms = interval between consecutive QQuickWindow::frameSwapped (software: emitted by the software render loop right after QBackingStore::flush of the dirty region (xcb, MIT-SHM); RHI OpenGL: after the GL swapBuffers of the basic render loop (Mesa llvmpipe)). QT_QPA_UPDATE_IDLE_TIME=0 (documented in QWindow::requestUpdate, recommended for benchmarking in the Scene Graph docs). Frames are rendered by Qt only when the scene changes (animations on Qt's 16 ms animation timer, resize, typing, cursor blink); every frameSwapped while measuring is counted. ui_stall_ms_max = longest gap between two firings of a 4 ms Qt::PreciseTimer on the UI thread (measure window only). setup_ms = process start (static init) -> first frameSwapped after the scenario data/items exist. _exit(0) after writing the JSON (no destructor teardown). ops.alloc_bytes null: no cheap public allocation counter (heap_inuse_bytes_end from mallinfo2 given instead).
version: Qt 6.12.0 (runtime 6.12.0, aqtinstall linux_gcc_64 from download.qt.io), g++ 13.3.0, CMake 4.4.4, Ninja 1.13.2
